title: Understanding the mechanism of water splitting on (111) and (001) surfaces of CsPbI2Br: time-domain ab initio analysis and DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4779-4788
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08275C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Harjot Singh, Neelam Minhas, Gh Mustafa, Gurinder Singh, Aman Kaura, J. K. Goswamy
NAMD results reveal that photocatalytic splitting of water is possible in CsPbI2Br. The splitting occurs due to the shifting of p-orbitals of the oxygen atom in the presence of light.
